data_gaps: All driver body profiles, including percentile-labelled adults and teenage examples, are illustrative estimates. Obtain validated anthropometry or individual measurements; no preset represents every person of an age, sex or body type.
Interior room (headroom, legroom, shoulder/hip room), H-point height: not published for EX60 - all seat/package coordinates are estimates.
Seat adjustment ranges, steering wheel diameter and tilt/telescope ranges: not published - estimates.
Mirror glass sizes and positions: not published - estimates.

Seat upholstery contours, headrest support, seams and mirror shell/glass outlines are original visual estimates, not photo-derived measurements. Local gallery 08 shows a tapered headrest with concealed support and shoulder panels; gallery 09 shows the exterior mirror cap/arm; gallery 01 shows the interior mirror. Exact trim variants, hidden mounts and mirror curvature remain unknown. Optional headrest speakers are reported by Car and Driver but are not modelled.

Exterior refinement inspected local gallery 02 (front three-quarter), 03 (full side), 05 (rear three-quarter), 09 (hammer light/hood detail), dashboard1.png and the cabin contact-sheet views 01/06/07/08. Observations: curved hood edges, concave lower doors, smooth closed nose, dark lower intake, split rear lamp groups and a continuous window/roof envelope. All section offsets, lamp sizes, panel curvature and finish settings remain unmeasured estimates; inspection transparency deliberately prevents production-appearance evaluation. Public Car and Driver text corroborates the smooth nose, hammer DRLs, tapered sides and sloping roof. Ars text was read for context, not used to change measured dimensions. No photogrammetry, factory CAD or production trim match.

Exterior panel cross-sections, glazing shape, wheel arches, wheel styling and cabin trim dimensions are visual estimates from press and local reference images; obtain EX60 CAD or measurement data before dimensional interpretation.
Retry Volvo spec sheet / owner's manual (support.volvocars.com) and first-drive reviews (Autocar, What Car?) manually, or replace with CAD/measured data from the test vehicle.

visual_reconstruction.note: Illustrative visual reconstruction from the supplied local CarImage gallery and dashboard reference, plus public press imagery. It does not change ergonomic hardpoints, adjustment ranges, sightline calculations or clearance geometry. Dimensions are unmeasured; screen content is generic and not a reproduction of Volvo software.

exterior_refinement.note: Photo-guided original procedural surfaces; no reference images or textures are embedded. Local 02/03/05/09 establish silhouettes and trim relationships, not metric measurements. Car and Driver corroborates smooth nose/hammer DRLs/tapered sides/sloping roof. All nested geometry and material parameters inherit this estimate provenance. Roof and doors retain inspection opacity.

wheel_detail.note: Visual interpretation of overview-exterior-gallery-10-1.webp: five branching two-tone spoke groups, dark barrel, rounded low-profile tire. Dimensions and hidden brake hardware are illustrative, not a measured wheel or tire specification.

dashboard.note: Second manual interpretation of interior-gallery-6 and overview-exterior-gallery-01-1. Layered curved fascia replaces coarse blocks; existing display centers and sizes remain unchanged. Screen graphics are generic procedural illustrations, not reproduced Volvo software. Hidden structure and all dimensions remain unmeasured.

seat_detail.note: Original parametric interpretation of CarImage overview-exterior-gallery-08-1.webp and -01-1.webp; not reverse-engineered CAD. All nested dimensions, ratios and materials inherit estimate confidence. Local contours are normalized by existing seat envelope dimensions; centers are mm in the unchanged cushion/recline frames. No exposed headrest poles are asserted because supports are concealed in the reference. Optional speaker hardware is omitted.

mirror_detail.note: Original sculpted interpretation of CarImage overview-exterior-gallery-09-1.webp (cap and black arm) and -01-1.webp (glass and interior rearview housing). Glass outlines, rim widths, shell depth and hidden mounting trim are estimates, not calibrated photographs. Outline ratios use unchanged metric glass width/height; local XY is the glass plane and +Z is its existing normal. Shell and rim remain behind glass at local Z=0. Left outline is reflected laterally. All nested dimensions/materials inherit estimate confidence.

data_gaps: Exterior cross-sections, wheel-arch shape, glazing curvature, trim dimensions, wheel design and dashboard dimensions are visual estimates, not measured EX60 CAD or validated package data.
Local CarImage images are a visual guide only; the rendered model is not a photorealistic or dimensionally verified reproduction.

inspection_transparency.note: Visualization-only transparency for cabin inspection; not the opacity of real EX60 panels. Door boundaries are approximate.
